scope: Actual native loader-v3 deployment, isolated synthetic wallet, no program/buffer secret keys or public transactions

checks.name: Wrong wallet, raised caps, changed seed journal and changed artifact are refused before signing
Wallet-base seeded buffer initialized atomically with exact authority
SDK refuses a changed on-chain buffer chunk without overwriting it
Public journal and chain bytes recover an interrupted first-chunk upload
Actual wallet cancellation before deployment retains only recoverable uploaded buffer
Missing signer and modified wallet message cause no broadcast
Every uploaded executable byte matches the reviewed artifact
Failed native deploy preserves complete buffer and rolls back seeded program
Native loader deploy accepts one wallet signer and no program/buffer keys
Buffer rent is reused and no funded upload buffer remains
Actually deployed binary executes and persists exact bootstrap domain
Actual native finalization removes upgrade authority and preserves executable bytes
Wallet-interface creator registration works after immutable native deployment
Fresh seeded deployment completes actual immutable token launch and independent receipt

deploymentEvidence.source: Finalized RPC native transaction, current loader-owned code bytes, and bounded successful program history. Not a light-client proof or proof that an RPC retained all older history.

executionReceipt.rpcTrust: Confirmed RPC account and transaction evidence; not a light-client state proof.
